typeChoice.legend: What do you want to add?

bankAccounts.title: Bank accounts
bankAccounts.description: Money you can spend or have set aside

investments.title: Investments & property
investments.description: Things you own whose value changes

checking.hint: Use a decimal point. Enter an overdrawn balance as a negative number.

savings.description: Money set aside or deposited for later

investment.hint: Enter the value of the holdings only and track settlement cash as a separate current account, so it is not counted twice. Use a decimal point.

brokerage.description: Securities with trades and daily prices
brokerage.hint: Its value comes from the trades you record and daily prices; the cash for each trade moves on a separate current account.

property.hint: Enter your own estimate of the current market value. Use a decimal point.

credit_card.description: Card spending you pay back later
credit_card.hint: Enter the amount you currently owe as a negative number, e.g. -350.00.

loan.hint: Enter the amount still owed as a negative number, e.g. -12000.00.

notices.expired: The bank authorization expired on <date></date>. Reconnect the bank to continue syncing.
notices.mismatch: The bank reports {reported} on <date></date>, but the bookings up to that day add up to {calculated}.

details.failure: This account could not be loaded
details.notFoundBody: It may have been removed, or the link belongs to another installation.

edit.title: Edit account
edit.name: Account name
edit.brokerageNote: Account type: {type}. A brokerage account holds securities and keeps its type.
edit.archivedNote: Account type: {type}. Restore the account to change its type.
edit.bankNote: Account type: {type}. A bank-synced account keeps the type from its bank connection.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.mismatch: Enter the account's exact name to confirm the deletion.
delete.warning: Deleting cannot be undone. To keep the history in reports, archive the account instead.
delete.effectBookings: All bookings of this account, their splits and its balance history are deleted. Net worth and cash flow no longer include them.
delete.effectTransfers: Transfers linked to bookings on other accounts stay there with their amounts, as transfers without a counterpart.
delete.effectRules: Rules that named this account as transfer target keep the transfer type without a counterpart account.
delete.confirmLabel: Type the account name to confirm

archive.title: Archive account
archive.bankNotice: An account can only be archived with a balance of 0. This account's balance follows its bank bookings, so Ufer cannot book it away. Archive it once its bookings bring the balance to 0.
archive.manualNotice: An account can only be archived with a balance of 0. Ufer books the remaining {amount} away, then archives the account.

summary.label: Account summary
summary.archived: Archived on <date></date> · hidden from lists, still counted in reports

valuation.title: Update balance
valuation.hint: The balance is derived from the account's transactions. Saving books the difference to the balance on that date as an adjustment, for example a revaluation.

create.title: Add account
create.description: Track an account, investment, property or debt by entering its balance yourself. Bank accounts with online access can also be added through Connect bank.
create.name: Name
create.hint: {hint} Leave the balance date empty to record the balance as of today.
create.add: Add {kind, select, checking {current account} savings {savings account} investment {investment account} property {property} credit_card {credit card} loan {loan} other {account}}

list.title: Accounts
list.failure: Your accounts could not be loaded
list.emptyBody: Add bank accounts, investments, property and debts to build your overview.

overview.title: Your accounts
overview.failure: Your accounts could not be loaded
overview.onboardingTitle: Your overview starts with your first account.
overview.onboarding: Connect your bank, or manually add accounts, investments, property and debts.
overview.onboardingSandbox: Connect a sandbox bank, or manually add accounts, investments, property and debts.

history.title: Balance history
history.failure: The balance history could not be loaded
history.empty: No balance has been recorded for this account yet.
history.single: The chart appears once a second balance is recorded.
history.differenceStarted: The current difference first appeared on <date></date>.
history.caption: Reported bank balances and their difference to the calculated balance, newest first
history.keyboardHint: Use the left and right arrow keys to explore balances, Home and End for the first and last date, and Escape to dismiss the selection.
